# MiCode Sp. z o.o.

> MiCode is a software development company based in Gdańsk, Poland. We build enterprise software with AI integrations, custom software, IT systems integration, and AI-powered products. Founder & CEO: Mikhail Peraviortkin.

MiCode Sp. z o.o. was incorporated in 2024; founder Michał Peraviortkin brings 18+ years of prior IT industry experience.

MiCode also designs and ships its own AI products: an accounting assistant for Polish tax law, a marketing automation platform, a personal budget assistant (mobile app), an Angular AI-chat component, an AI test orchestration platform, and a relocation-assistant knowledge base.

Languages: Polish (default), English, Russian. The site is prerendered into three separate locale trees — `/` (Polish, default), `/en/…`, and `/ru/…` — each a real, independently crawlable URL. Every page carries a self-referencing canonical and reciprocal `hreflang` tags (`x-default` points to the Polish version). For example: the homepage is `https://mi-code.pl/` (Polish), `https://mi-code.pl/en/` (English), `https://mi-code.pl/ru/` (Russian); a product page is `https://mi-code.pl/products/accounting-ai/` (Polish) and `https://mi-code.pl/en/products/accounting-ai/` (English).

Contact: development@mi-code.pl — Jana Heweliusza 11 lok. 811, 80-890 Gdańsk, Poland.

## Company

- [Homepage](https://mi-code.pl/): Company overview — services (enterprise software development, AI integrations, custom software, IT systems integration, data analysis, cloud solutions), founder profile, key projects (incl. an enterprise supply chain management system with 300+ REST endpoints and AI agents for Text2SQL/RAG), and contact form.

## Products

- [Accounting AI Agent](https://mi-code.pl/products/accounting-ai/): AI assistant for accounting professionals and business owners in Poland. Integrates with the wFirma accounting platform, advises on VAT/PIT/CIT tax compliance and ZUS requirements, automates invoice processing and financial calculations. Website: eKsiegowyAi.pl
- [Marketing AI Assistant (eMarketing AI)](https://mi-code.pl/products/emarketing-ai/): AI-powered marketing automation SaaS — content generation (social posts, blogs, emails, ads), multi-channel campaign management, email marketing with subscriber management, an interactive AI chat assistant for marketing strategy, AI-generated documents/checklists, and an analytics dashboard. Website: eMarketingAI.pl
- [AI Budget Assistant](https://mi-code.pl/products/budget-assistant/): Mobile personal finance app — expense tracking by voice, receipt OCR scanning, or manual entry; multi-currency budgets; a GPT-4-powered finance chat; gamified "Spending Stories" insights; shared/business accounts with role-based access. Available on Google Play and GitHub. Website: ai-budget.pl
- [ngx-open-web-ui-chat](https://mi-code.pl/products/ngx-chat/): Open-source Angular component that adds AI chat (via Open WebUI) to any Angular application with a single npm install. Supports streaming responses, markdown rendering, and full customization. Free, available on npm.
- [Testing AI Assistant](https://mi-code.pl/products/testing-ai/): AI-powered test orchestration platform — automated test execution with intelligent scheduling, AI-generated test cases from codebase analysis, quality checklists for releases, and continuous AI-driven test coverage monitoring.
- [Legalka KB](https://mi-code.pl/products/legalka-kb/): Free Telegram bot (@legalka_pl_bot) that helps people relocate to and legalise their stay in Poland. Answers strictly from a verified, curated knowledge base (RAG over a two-layer "norm" + "practice" base) and honestly says "I don't know" instead of hallucinating when a topic isn't covered. Supports Russian, Ukrainian, Belarusian, Polish, and English.

## Blog

- [How AI agents optimised supply chain management](https://mi-code.pl/blog/scm-ai-agents-supply-chain/): Case study of an enterprise SCM system built with Java 21 + Spring Boot 3.2 — 300+ REST endpoints, a Text2SQL module for natural-language database queries, and a RAG system for supplier-contract and documentation Q&A. Report preparation time dropped from 8 hours to 20 minutes; order errors fell 34%.
- [How to add AI chat to Angular in 15 minutes](https://mi-code.pl/blog/ngx-open-web-ui-chat-tutorial/): Step-by-step tutorial for integrating the ngx-open-web-ui-chat component into an Angular app — npm install, module setup, and Open WebUI configuration (apiUrl, model parameters).
- [Automating Polish accounting compliance with an AI agent](https://mi-code.pl/blog/accounting-ai-polish-tax-automation/): How Accounting AI Agent connects to wFirma's API to read real invoices and company data, answer VAT/PIT/CIT questions, and flag issues like incomplete company addresses.
- [Inside eMarketing AI: one platform for AI-generated content, campaigns, and email](https://mi-code.pl/blog/emarketing-ai-content-automation/): Why eMarketing AI combines content generation, campaign management, email marketing, and an AI chat assistant in a single SaaS platform instead of several disconnected tools.
- [Receipts, voice, or chat: how AI Budget Assistant tracks spending without the spreadsheet](https://mi-code.pl/blog/ai-budget-assistant-receipt-ocr-gpt4/): How AI Budget Assistant combines receipt OCR, voice input, a GPT-4 finance chat, multi-currency budgets, and gamification to keep people logging expenses.
- [Letting AI agents own the boring parts of QA](https://mi-code.pl/blog/testing-ai-agent-orchestration/): How Testing AI Assistant generates test cases from a codebase, orchestrates execution with intelligent scheduling and retry logic, and keeps quality checklists and coverage up to date.
- [How Legalka KB uses AI: RAG, voice, and zero hallucinations](https://mi-code.pl/blog/legalka-kb-ai-architecture/): A walkthrough of the relocation bot's entire AI stack: embeddings and retrieval, query rewriting, grounded answers with abstention, voice in/out, a practice-ingest pipeline, and an eval judge.
- [Inside Accounting AI Agent: one agent, 80+ tools, and real wFirma data](https://mi-code.pl/blog/accounting-ai-agent-architecture/): A look under the hood of Accounting AI Agent: a single LangGraph agent, up to 82 tools, grounding in wFirma and Polish registries, KSeF, receipt OCR, and rule-based long-term memory.
- [How AI Budget Assistant uses AI: a function-calling agent, vision, voice, and data protection](https://mi-code.pl/blog/ai-budget-assistant-ai-architecture/): A look under the hood of AI in AI Budget Assistant: one server-side key and three model "speeds", a function-calling chat agent, data isolated from instructions, vision receipt OCR, voice, bots — and where AI was deliberately skipped.
- [Inside eMarketing AI: a supervisor and a team of specialist AI agents](https://mi-code.pl/blog/emarketing-ai-agent-architecture/): A look under the hood of eMarketing AI: a supervisor routes work to specialist agents (content, checklists, documents, SEO, strategy, email, analytics), queue-backed runs, grounding in the project's real data, and one GPT-4o tuned per task.
- [Sleep on it: AI agent teams that improve overnight](https://mi-code.pl/blog/self-improving-agent-teams/): The methodology behind self-improving AI agent teams — a scheduled nightly self-study loop where each agent re-reads its own instructions, detects drift against the codebase, and proposes edits to itself for a human to approve; plus multi-lens scanners (tech-debt, product ideas), orchestration with quality gates, and repo-native markdown artifacts. Connects the approach to Andrej Karpathy's "system prompt learning" and sleep/consolidation ideas.
- [GEO and AEO: how to get found when AI answers for the user](https://mi-code.pl/blog/geo-aeo-generative-answer-engine-optimization/): What Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) are, how they emerged (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and the 2023 "GEO: Generative Engine Optimization" research paper), how they differ from classic SEO, and how MiCode applies them portfolio-wide — a curated llms.txt, a robots.txt that welcomes AI crawlers while protecting private routes, FAQPage and Organization JSON-LD, and a trilingual prerender — plus a practical checklist.
- [What an AI agent really costs per month](https://mi-code.pl/blog/ai-agent-cost-per-month-model/): A forward-looking cost model for running an LLM agent — why the bill is dominated by what gets re-sent on every step of the agent loop (system prompt, tool schemas, conversation history, retrieved context) rather than by questions and answers; four places budget leaks and four levers that cut it, including prompt caching at roughly 90% off cached input; plus an interactive calculator. Explicitly a model on declared assumptions, not MiCode billing data.
- [The AI Act in August 2026: what was postponed, and what applies today](https://mi-code.pl/blog/ai-act-sierpien-2026-co-obowiazuje/): What the Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, in force 27 July 2026) actually deferred — Annex III high-risk obligations to 2 December 2027 and Annex I to 2 August 2028 — against what applies now: Article 50 transparency duties for chatbots, synthetic content, deepfakes and emotion recognition from 2 August 2026 (with a four-month grace period for machine-readable marking, through 2 December 2026), the Commission's powers to fine GPAI providers, and Poland's act on AI systems in force from 11 August 2026 with KRiBSI as supervisor and administrative fines from 28 October 2026. Includes a compliance-date table, a timeline, and six practical steps.
- [Is there an AI assistant connected to wFirma? Yes — it's called Accounting AI Agent](https://mi-code.pl/blog/asystent-ai-wfirma-vat-pit/): A direct answer to the question Polish business owners actually type. Yes, an AI assistant that connects to a wFirma account exists — Accounting AI Agent (hosted as eKsiegowyAi), built by MiCode. Covers what it answers (VAT/PIT/CIT/ZUS rules plus questions about your own invoices, contractors, bank accounts, and registered address read live from wFirma), where the data comes from (wFirma API, Biała Lista and KRS registries, the official tax-deadline calendar, plus the mandatory White List check for payments of 15,000 zł and over under Art. 117ba), what it will not do (no filing of tax declarations, no replacement for an accountant or tax adviser, wFirma-only integration), and what it costs to try (free and open on GitHub, subscription hosting on eKsiegowyAi.pl, with the OpenAI or Google Gemini key belonging to the user).
- [KSeF 2026: What to Do If You Are Not Ready Yet](https://mi-code.pl/blog/ksef-2026-co-zrobic-jesli-nie-jestes-gotowy/): KSeF is mandatory since February and April 2026 and the penalty-free window closes on 31 December. Four ways to catch up, the API integration, and a checklist.
- [AI Grants in Poland 2026: What Is Open and the R&D Relief](https://mi-code.pl/blog/dotacje-na-ai-dla-firm-2026/): Which Polish AI funding calls are open in August 2026, what happened to KPO, and why the R&D relief and IP Box usually beat a grant on a small deployment.
- [AI-citation monitor inside Gemini's free-tier quota](https://mi-code.pl/blog/ai-citation-monitor-gemini-free-quota/): How MiCode paces a 54-call AI-citation sweep across three days inside Gemini's 20-call daily free tier, with retries and a prompt-list fingerprint.

## FAQ

- **What is Accounting AI Agent?** An AI assistant for accounting professionals and business owners in Poland that combines AI with deep knowledge of Polish tax law and integrates with the wFirma accounting platform.
- **Does Accounting AI Agent integrate with wFirma?** Yes — it integrates directly with wFirma for automatic data synchronization and real-time access to financial documents, eliminating manual data entry.
- **What is AI Budget Assistant?** A mobile personal finance app that lets you track expenses by voice, receipt scanning (AI OCR), or manual entry, with multi-currency budgets and a GPT-4-powered finance chat.
- **Where can I download AI Budget Assistant?** It's available on Google Play, and the source code is on GitHub.
- **What is eMarketing AI?** An AI-powered marketing automation SaaS platform for generating content, managing campaigns, sending emails, and tracking analytics — all in one place.
- **What pricing plans does eMarketing AI offer?** FREE with 50 AI generations/month, PRO with 500 generations and up to 5 team members, and ENTERPRISE with unlimited resources — new accounts get a 14-day free trial.
- **What is ngx-open-web-ui-chat?** An open-source Angular component that adds AI chat functionality to any Angular application by connecting directly to an Open WebUI instance.
- **Is ngx-open-web-ui-chat free?** Yes, it's free and open source, available on npm.
- **What is Testing AI Assistant?** An AI-powered test orchestration platform that automates test execution, generates test cases from codebase analysis, and provides quality insights from a single interface.
- **How much does Testing AI Assistant cost?** It's free during the testing period; source code is available on GitHub.
- **What is Legalka KB?** A Telegram bot and knowledge base for legalisation in Poland. It answers strictly from verified sources with references to laws and real applicant experience, and honestly says "I don't know" if there's no answer in the base.
- **Is Legalka KB free?** Yes — it's a free Telegram bot at @legalka_pl_bot.
- **What drives the cost of running an AI agent?** Mostly re-sent context: the system prompt and every tool schema travel in each request on each step of the agent loop, so a tool-heavy agent doing multi-step work pays for that prefix many times per task.
- **How much does prompt caching save on an AI agent?** Cached input tokens cost roughly 90% less than regular input tokens, so keeping a stable prefix at the front of the prompt is the single largest lever on an agent's bill.
- **Was the EU AI Act postponed?** Partly: the Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744) deferred the high-risk obligations to 2 December 2027 (Annex III) and 2 August 2028 (Annex I), but Article 50 transparency duties and the Commission's powers to fine GPAI providers apply from 2 August 2026.
- **Do I have to tell users they are talking to an AI chatbot?** Yes — Article 50(1) of the AI Act requires it from 2 August 2026: clearly and distinguishably, at the latest at the first interaction, unless it is obvious to a reasonably well-informed, observant and circumspect person.
- **What is KRiBSI?** Poland's AI market supervisory authority created by the act on artificial intelligence systems, in force from 11 August 2026 — an independent collegial body supported by the Ministry of Digital Affairs, able to impose administrative fines from 28 October 2026.
- **Is there an AI assistant that connects to a wFirma account?** Yes — Accounting AI Agent, built by MiCode and hosted as eKsiegowyAi. It connects to wFirma through the API and answers VAT, PIT, CIT, and ZUS questions against the business's real invoices, contractors, bank accounts, and company data. The code is free and open on GitHub; managed hosting is available by subscription at eKsiegowyAi.pl.
- **Does Accounting AI Agent file tax declarations?** No. It calculates, checks, and prepares documents, but submitting a declaration to the tax office — and the responsibility for it — stays with the user and their accountant. Structured invoices are the exception: those it can send to KSeF in the FA(3) format and collect the official confirmation (UPO) for.
